title: Spread salam
lines: Want something that makes hearts love each other?
quote_en: Shall I tell you something that, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread salam among yourselves.
arabic: أولا أدلكم على شيء إذا فعلتموه تحاببتم؟ أفشوا السلام بينكم
arabic_key: أولا أدلكم على شيء إذا فعلتموه تحاببتم أفشوا السلام بينكم
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Your smile is charity
lines: You still have something to give.
quote_en: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
arabic: تبسمك في وجه أخيك لك صدقة
arabic_key: تبسمك في وجه أخيك لك صدقة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The forgotten siwak
lines: Before every prayer, there is a sunnah we barely see anymore.
He said he would have commanded it, if not for the hardship.
quote_en: Were it not that I would burden my ummah, or the people, I would command them to use the siwak with every prayer.
arabic: لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي، أَوْ عَلَى النَّاسِ لَأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ مَعَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
arabic_key: لولا أن أشق على أمتي أو على الناس لأمرتهم بالسواك مع كل صلاة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Two rak‘ahs of Duha
lines: Every morning, charity is due on every part of you.
Most of us never think about it.
quote_en: Two rak‘ahs that he prays in the forenoon suffice for all of that.
arabic: ويجزئ من ذلك ركعتان يركعهما من الضحى
arabic_key: ويجزئ من ذلك ركعتان يركعهما من الضحى
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Bismillah and the right hand
lines: A boy’s hand wandered all over the plate.
quote_en: Boy, say Bismillah, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is in front of you.
arabic: يا غلام سم الله وكل بيمينك وكل مما يليك
arabic_key: يا غلام سم الله وكل بيمينك وكل مما يليك
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: He served his family
lines: Aisha was asked: what did he do at home?
He was busy serving his family.
^Then the prayer was called, and he went out.
quote_en: He used to be in the service of his family, and when the prayer came, he would go out to pray.
arabic: كَانَ يَكُونُ فِي مِهْنَةِ أَهْلِهِ، فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ
arabic_key: كان يكون في مهنة أهله فإذا حضرت الصلاة خرج إلى الصلاة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Never belittle a good deed
lines: You think it’s too small to matter.
He said: do not look down on any good.
^Even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
quote_en: Do not belittle any good, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
arabic: لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئا، ولو أن تلقى أخاك بوجه طلق
arabic_key: لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئا ولو أن تلقى أخاك بوجه طلق
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Visit the sick
lines: Someone you know is in bed today.
^Those who visit are in the harvest of Paradise.
quote_en: Whoever visits a sick person remains in the fruit-gathering of Paradise until he returns.
arabic_key: من عاد مريضا لم يزل في خرفة الجنة حتى يرجع
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Give a gift
lines: A small gift. A big effect.
^Give gifts, and you will love each other.
quote_en: Give gifts to one another and you will love one another.
arabic_key: تهادوا تحابوا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Your neighbour’s right
lines: Jibril kept advising him about the neighbour.
^Until he thought the neighbour would inherit.
quote_en: Jibril kept advising me about the neighbour until I thought he would make him an heir.
arabic_key: ما زال جبريل يوصيني بالجار حتى ظننت أنه سيورثه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Feed and greet
lines: Someone asked: which Islam is best?
^Feed people, and greet those you know and don’t know.
quote_en: That you feed people and give salam to those you know and those you do not know.
arabic_key: تطعم الطعام وتقرأ السلام على من عرفت ومن لم تعرف
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Remove harm from the road
lines: One small act on your walk today.
A stone. A peel. A branch.
quote_en: The lowest of them is removing harm from the road.
arabic_key: فأفضلها قول لا إله إلا الله وأدناها إماطة الأذى عن الطريق
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Monday and Thursday
lines: Deeds are presented to Allah twice a week.
He wanted his to arrive in a certain state.
quote_en: Deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and I love that my deeds be presented while I am fasting.
arabic_key: تعرض الأعمال يوم الاثنين والخميس فأحب أن يعرض عملي وأنا صائم
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Three days every month
quote_en: Fasting three days of every month is like fasting all the time.
arabic_key: صيام ثلاثة أيام من كل شهر صيام الدهر كله
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Six days of Shawwal
lines: ^And it is like a year of fasting.
quote_en: Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is like fasting the whole year.
arabic_key: من صام رمضان ثم أتبعه ستا من شوال كان كصيام الدهر
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Sleep like the Prophet ﷺ
lines: Your last moments before sleep matter.
^End the day the way he did.
quote_en: When you go to your bed, perform wudu as for prayer, then lie on your right side.
arabic_key: إذا أتيت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: A guardian through the night
lines: He caught the thief of the food.
quote_en: Recite Ayat al-Kursi when you go to your bed; a guardian from Allah will remain with you.
arabic_key: إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرأ آية الكرسي لن يزال عليك من الله حافظ
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Two verses that suffice
quote_en: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
arabic_key: من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The last third of the night
lines: ^Is there anyone asking? Anyone seeking forgiveness?
quote_en: Our Lord descends each night to the lowest heaven when the last third of the night remains.
arabic_key: ينزل ربنا تبارك وتعالى كل ليلة إلى السماء الدنيا حين يبقى ثلث الليل الآخر
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The two rak‘ahs of Fajr
quote_en: The two rak‘ahs of Fajr are better than the world and all it contains.
arabic_key: ركعتا الفجر خير من الدنيا وما فيها
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Twelve rak‘ahs, one house
lines: ^A house is built for you in Paradise.
quote_en: Whoever prays twelve rak‘ahs in a day and night, a house will be built for him in Paradise.
arabic_key: ما من عبد مسلم يصلي لله كل يوم ثنتي عشرة ركعة تطوعا غير فريضة إلا بنى الله له بيتا في الجنة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Greet the masjid
lines: You walked in and sat down.
quote_en: When one of you enters the masjid, he should not sit until he prays two rak‘ahs.
arabic_key: إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فلا يجلس حتى يصلي ركعتين
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Wudu at home, then walk
quote_en: One step erases a sin and the other raises a rank.
arabic_key: من تطهر في بيته ثم مشى إلى بيت من بيوت الله ليقضي فريضة من فرائض الله كانت خطواته إحداها تحط خطيئة والأخرى ترفع درجة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: If they only knew
lines: He said: if people knew what is in the adhan and the first row.
They would draw lots for it.
quote_en: If people knew what is in the call to prayer and the first row, they would have to draw lots for it.
arabic_key: لو يعلم الناس ما في النداء والصف الأول ثم لم يجدوا إلا أن يستهموا عليه لاستهموا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Dua between adhan and iqamah
quote_en: A supplication made between the adhan and the iqamah is not rejected.
arabic_key: الدعاء لا يرد بين الأذان والإقامة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Answer the caller
quote_en: When you hear the call, say what the muadhdhin says.
arabic_key: إذا سمعتم النداء فقولوا مثل ما يقول المؤذن
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: After every prayer
quote_en: Whoever glorifies Allah thirty-three times after every prayer, praises Him thirty-three, and magnifies Him thirty-three...
arabic_key: من سبح الله في دبر كل صلاة ثلاثا وثلاثين وحمد الله ثلاثا وثلاثين وكبر الله ثلاثا وثلاثين
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Salawat
quote_en: Whoever sends one salawat upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.
arabic_key: من صلى علي صلاة صلى الله عليه بها عشرا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: A hundred a day
quote_en: Whoever says it a hundred times a day, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
arabic_key: من قال سبحان الله وبحمده في يوم مائة مرة حطت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Light on the tongue
quote_en: Two words, light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful.
arabic_key: كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان ثقيلتان في الميزان حبيبتان إلى الرحمن
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: He sought forgiveness daily
quote_en: By Allah, I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.
arabic_key: والله إني لأستغفر الله وأتوب إليه في اليوم أكثر من سبعين مرة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Dua in their absence
lines: Ask for your brother when he can’t hear you.
^And says: and for you the same.
quote_en: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother in his absence is answered.
arabic_key: دعوة المرء المسلم لأخيه بظهر الغيب مستجابة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Say Bismillah at the door
quote_en: When a man enters his house and mentions Allah, Shaytan says: no lodging and no dinner for you.
arabic_key: إذا دخل الرجل بيته فذكر الله عند دخوله وعند طعامه قال الشيطان لا مبيت لكم ولا عشاء
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Greet your own family
quote_en: When you enter upon your family, give salam; it will be a blessing upon you and your household.
arabic_key: إذا دخلت على أهلك فسلم يكون بركة عليك وعلى أهل بيتك
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Greet the children
lines: ^Because that was what the Prophet ﷺ did.
quote_en: He passed by some children and greeted them, and said: the Prophet ﷺ used to do this.
arabic_key: أنه مر على صبيان فسلم عليهم وقال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يفعله
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Kiss your child
lines: A man said: I have ten children.
^He ﷺ said: who shows no mercy, receives none.
quote_en: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
arabic_key: من لا يرحم لا يرحم
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The best of you
lines: Not the best in the masjid.
quote_en: The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.
arabic_key: خيركم خيركم لأهله وأنا خيركم لأهلي
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Be kind to women
quote_en: Treat women well.
arabic_key: استوصوا بالنساء خيرا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Gentleness
lines: Where it is found, it beautifies.
Where it is removed, it disfigures.
quote_en: Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it.
arabic_key: إن الرفق لا يكون في شيء إلا زانه ولا ينزع من شيء إلا شانه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Real strength
lines: Not the one who wins every fight.
^The one who controls himself in anger.
quote_en: The strong one is not the wrestler; the strong one is who controls himself when angry.
arabic_key: ليس الشديد بالصرعة إنما الشديد الذي يملك نفسه عند الغضب
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Just one word
quote_en: Do not become angry.
arabic_key: لا تغضب
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Speak good, or be silent
quote_en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
arabic_key: من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليقل خيرا أو ليصمت
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: What doesn’t concern you
quote_en: Part of the excellence of a person’s Islam is leaving what does not concern him.
arabic_key: من حسن إسلام المرء تركه ما لا يعنيه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Truth leads somewhere
quote_en: Stick to truthfulness, for truthfulness leads to righteousness and righteousness leads to Paradise.
arabic_key: عليكم بالصدق فإن الصدق يهدي إلى البر وإن البر يهدي إلى الجنة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Modesty
lines: It is a branch of faith.
quote_en: Modesty is part of faith.
arabic_key: الحياء من الإيمان
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The heaviest thing on the scale
quote_en: Nothing is heavier on the believer’s scale on the Day of Judgement than good character.
arabic_key: ما من شيء أثقل في ميزان المؤمن يوم القيامة من خلق حسن
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Humility raises you
lines: ^Humble yourself for Allah, and He raises you.
quote_en: No one humbles himself for Allah except that Allah raises him.
arabic_key: وما تواضع أحد لله إلا رفعه الله
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Secret charity
lines: ^His left hand didn’t know what his right gave.
quote_en: A man who gave charity and hid it so that his left hand did not know what his right had given.
arabic_key: ورجل تصدق بصدقة فأخفاها حتى لا تعلم شماله ما تنفق يمينه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Make peace between people
lines: Better than fasting, prayer and charity?
quote_en: Shall I tell you of something better than the rank of fasting, prayer and charity? Reconciling between people.
arabic_key: ألا أخبركم بأفضل من درجة الصيام والصلاة والصدقة قالوا بلى قال إصلاح ذات البين
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Don’t cut family ties
lines: ^The one who cuts ties will not enter Paradise.
quote_en: The one who severs the ties of kinship will not enter Paradise.
arabic_key: لا يدخل الجنة قاطع رحم
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Ties lengthen life
quote_en: Whoever wishes to have his provision expanded and his life extended, let him maintain family ties.
arabic_key: من أحب أن يبسط له في رزقه وينسأ له في أثره فليصل رحمه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Even if they cut you off
quote_en: The one who maintains ties is not the one who merely returns the favour.
arabic_key: ليس الواصل بالمكافئ ولكن الواصل الذي إذا قطعت رحمه وصلها
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Ease someone’s hardship
lines: ^Allah eases yours on the Day it matters.
quote_en: Whoever relieves a believer of a worldly hardship, Allah will relieve him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection.
arabic_key: من نفس عن مؤمن كربة من كرب الدنيا نفس الله عنه كربة من كرب يوم القيامة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Pardon the debtor
lines: Told his boys: forgive the struggling.
quote_en: He would say to his young men: overlook him, perhaps Allah will overlook us.
arabic_key: تجاوزوا عنه لعل الله أن يتجاوز عنا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The honest merchant
lines: Business is not a test you fail.
quote_en: The truthful, trustworthy merchant is with the prophets, the truthful, and the martyrs.
arabic_key: التاجر الصدوق الأمين مع النبيين والصديقين والشهداء
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Be easy in dealings
quote_en: May Allah have mercy on a man who is lenient when he sells, buys and asks for his due.
arabic_key: رحم الله رجلا سمحا إذا باع وإذا اشترى وإذا اقتضى
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Plant a tree
lines: A bird, a person, an animal.
quote_en: No Muslim plants a tree or sows a crop and a bird, person or animal eats from it, except that it is charity for him.
arabic_key: ما من مسلم يغرس غرسا أو يزرع زرعا فيأكل منه طير أو إنسان أو بهيمة إلا كان له به صدقة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Mercy to animals
lines: A man saw a thirsty dog.
He climbed down into a well.
quote_en: There is a reward for every living creature.
arabic_key: في كل كبد رطبة أجر
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: The dua after wudu
quote_en: The eight gates of Paradise are opened for him; he may enter by whichever he wishes.
arabic_key: إلا فتحت له أبواب الجنة الثمانية يدخل من أيها شاء
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Sins fall away with wudu
lines: ^Sins drip away with the last drop.
quote_en: When a Muslim servant performs wudu, every sin he looked at with his eyes leaves with the water.
arabic_key: إذا توضأ العبد المسلم فغسل وجهه خرج من وجهه كل خطيئة نظر إليها بعينيه مع الماء
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Don’t fill the stomach
lines: The worst container a person fills.
quote_en: No human fills a vessel worse than his stomach.
arabic_key: ما ملأ آدمي وعاء شرا من بطنه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: He never criticised food
lines: If he liked it, he ate.
quote_en: The Prophet ﷺ never criticised any food.
arabic_key: ما عاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم طعاما قط
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Finish what is on your plate
lines: You don’t know where the barakah is.
quote_en: You do not know in which part of your food the blessing lies.
arabic_key: فإنه لا يدري في أي طعامه البركة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Food for two
quote_en: The food of two is enough for three, and the food of three is enough for four.
arabic_key: طعام الاثنين كافي الثلاثة وطعام الثلاثة كافي الأربعة
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: After the meal
quote_en: Praise be to Allah, an abundant, pure and blessed praise.
arabic_key: الحمد لله حمدا كثيرا طيبا مباركا فيه
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Drink in three breaths
quote_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to breathe three times while drinking.
arabic_key: كان يتنفس في الشراب ثلاثا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: When someone sneezes
quote_en: When one of you sneezes, let him say: Alhamdulillah, and his brother should say: Yarhamukallah.
arabic_key: إذا عطس أحدكم فليقل الحمد لله وليقل له أخوه يرحمك الله
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: When you yawn
quote_en: When one of you yawns, let him cover his mouth with his hand, for Shaytan enters.
arabic_key: إذا تثاءب أحدكم فليمسك بيده على فيه فإن الشيطان يدخل
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Ask permission, three times
quote_en: Seeking permission is three times; if you are given permission, enter, otherwise return.
arabic_key: الاستئذان ثلاث فإن أذن لك وإلا فارجع
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Shake hands
quote_en: No two Muslims meet and shake hands except that they are forgiven before they part.
arabic_key: ما من مسلمين يلتقيان فيتصافحان إلا غفر لهما قبل أن يتفرقا
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Don’t whisper in front of a third
quote_en: If you are three, two should not whisper together leaving out the third.
arabic_key: إذا كنتم ثلاثة فلا يتناجى اثنان دون الثالث
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: Sleep early, wake early
lines: ^The night belongs to rest and prayer.
quote_en: The Prophet ﷺ disliked sleeping before Isha and talking after it.
arabic_key: كان يكره النوم قبلها والحديث بعدها
translation_note: Draft meaning-translation; compare with a published translation before posting.

title: In Allah’s protection
lines: ^You are in Allah’s protection all day.
quote_en: Whoever prays the morning prayer is in Allah’s protection.
